name: The Goblins of Brackenford Are Moving Inward

game.core.world.secret.summary: Goblin attacks near Brackenford have become less frequent because whole bands are moving deeper into the Greenmantle with supplies instead of raiding outward. Birds vanish from the old patrol road at twilight.
game.core.world.secret.provenance: Approved as a local-setting GM mystery during the world-creation interview (2026-08-22).
